name: Product Shot
summary: Turns a plain photo of a product into a styled product shot: pedestal, splash, beach and more.

source.notes: Same pipeline as edit; the scene is wrapped in a product-preserving template. Wording still to tune in the lab.

inputs.label: Product photo
inputs.help: Any clear photo of the product; the background does not matter

inputs.label: Scene
inputs.default: on a white marble pedestal, soft studio light, clean light grey background, a gentle shadow

options.value: on a white marble pedestal, soft studio light, clean light grey background, a gentle shadow
options.label: Marble pedestal

options.value: on wet black stone with water droplets, dramatic rim light, dark background
options.label: Wet stone, dramatic

options.value: on a sunlit wooden table by a window, morning light, plants softly blurred behind
options.label: Morning table

options.value: floating in mid-air with water splashing around it, high-speed photo, blue gradient background
options.label: Splash

options.value: on a towel in the sand, bright summer sun, the ocean softly blurred behind
options.label: Beach

options.value: in a minimalist pastel set with geometric shapes, soft even light
options.label: Pastel set

options.value: held in a hand on a city street at golden hour, shallow depth of field
options.label: In hand, street

bind.template: Product photography: the product from <ref_image_0> {scene}. Keep the product identical: shape, label, text and colors. {details}

inputs.label: Anything else (optional)
inputs.help: e.g. add fresh lemons around it, top-down view
